_comment: Release gate A12: the versioned reference source of the Home Assistant client hassemu answers. The emulation is verified against the Android companion app: the OAuth2 browser flow, the mobile_app registration and webhook, the websocket command set, the manifest.json probe, the loader that waits for connection-status or the `loaded` event, and the safe-area insets. The iOS app and the Home Assistant frontend read the same version switch (HA_VERSION in src/lib/constants.ts); the gate reads one source.
_verified: 2026-11-07, read against 2026.9.0 (the tag of the 2026-09-25 audit). `serverReportsLoaded` still starts at 2026.8.0 and CONNECTION_TIMEOUT is still 10 s (FrontendViewModel.kt), so HA_VERSION 2026.4.0 stays below the loaded switch. The manifest probe now also requires a 2xx status; hassemu answers 200 with name "Home Assistant". A start or deep-link URL outside the server origin now opens externally; hassemu's pages stay on their own origin and frame the target. The `--app-safe-area-inset-*` variables are unchanged (WebViewAction.kt). The external bus gained matter/share_device and an error result, and the JS bridge skips a second registration. The authentication, integration and websocket changes are internal. Raising this value means reading the watched paths of the new release against HA_VERSION, external-bridge.ts, redirect-wrapper.ts, auth-page.ts, mobile-app-routes.ts, ha-websocket.ts and the manifest route again.
